div.head: Wl lad 3.2
div.ab: ⁊ gif se Englisca ne durre hine to orneste beclypian, werige hine se Fræncisca mid unforedan aðe.
Et si Anglicus non audeat eum probare per bellum, defendat se Francigena plano iuramento (non in uerborum obseruantiis).
7 gif se Englisca ne durre hine to orneste beclypian, werige hine se Fræncisca mid unforedan aðe.
3, 2. Und [nur] wenn der Englische ihn zum Zweikampf zu fordern nicht wagt, vertheidige sich der Französische durch ungestabten Reinigungseid (schlichten Eid, nicht mit Wortform-Gefahr Q.).

3, 2. And [only] if the Englishman does not dare to challenge him to combat, the Frenchman shall defend himself by an unformal oath of exculpation (simple oath, not with the danger of the word-form Q.).
And if the Englishman dare not summon him to trial by combat, the Frenchman shall defend himself by a comprehensive oath.
div.note: Added October 2026 from Robertson pp. 232–233 (text and translation); Liebermann’s text and German translation added from Gesetze I p. 484, October 2026 (two independent readings of the page images)
